answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with licensed harbor fog-bell keepers: each identity tends one fog bell mounted on a marble plinth at a working harbor, its unique pulse pattern logged daily by the harbor master. Random checks summon the holder to ring that exact bell live within minutes, and one operator cannot staff two bells in the same fog. The license fee in outside money doubles per further bell on the same funding trail, so each extra fake identity costs another real bell, another season of night watches, another human, and twice the prior fee.
